f3_program: observe(at("paul.earnings.hourly_rate", "work_period"), 12.50, "dollar_per_hour", source("$12.50 for each hour that he works"))
observe(at("paul.work.duration", "work_period"), 40, "hour", source("working 40 hours"))
rate_relation(at("paul.earnings.balance", "initial"), at("paul.earnings.hourly_rate", "work_period"), at("paul.work.duration", "work_period"), source("Paul earns $12.50 for each hour that he works"))
percent_of("paul.taxes_and_fees.amount", at("paul.earnings.balance", "current"), 20, source("pay 20% for taxes and fees"))
remove("taxes_and_fees_payment", "paul", at("paul.earnings.balance", "current"), "paul.taxes_and_fees.amount", source("pay 20% for taxes and fees"))

transfer("paycheck_receipt", "paul", at("paul.earnings.balance", "current"), at("paul.paycheck.balance", "current"), at("paul.earnings.balance", "current"), source("After working 40 hours, Paul receives his paycheck"))
percent_of("paul.gummy_bears.spending.amount", at("paul.paycheck.balance", "current"), 15, source("spends 15% of his paycheck on gummy bears"))
remove("gummy_bears_purchase", "paul", at("paul.paycheck.balance", "current"), "paul.gummy_bears.spending.amount", source("spends 15% of his paycheck on gummy bears"))
query("value", at("paul.paycheck.balance", "current"))
collection("tim.zoo.animal_purchase_costs", "purchase_cost", "tim.zoo", source("He buys 3 goats for $400 each.  He gets twice as many llamas which cost 50% more each"))
add("goat_purchase", "tim", at("tim.zoo.goats.count", "current"), 3, source("He buys 3 goats"))
observe(at("tim.zoo.goats.unit_price", "purchase"), 400, "dollar_per_goat", source("$400 each"))
rate_relation("tim.zoo.goats.purchase.cost", at("tim.zoo.goats.unit_price", "purchase"), event_field("goat_purchase", "quantity"), source("buys 3 goats for $400 each"))
member("tim.zoo.animal_purchase_costs", "tim.zoo.goats.purchase.cost", source("buys 3 goats for $400 each"))
add("llama_purchase", "tim", at("tim.zoo.llamas.count", "current"), scale(event_field("goat_purchase", "quantity"), 2), source("He gets twice as many llamas"))
percent_more(at("tim.zoo.llamas.unit_price", "purchase"), at("tim.zoo.goats.unit_price", "purchase"), 50, source("cost 50% more each"))
rate_relation("tim.zoo.llamas.purchase.cost", at("tim.zoo.llamas.unit_price", "purchase"), event_field("llama_purchase", "quantity"), source("gets twice as many llamas which cost 50% more each"))
member("tim.zoo.animal_purchase_costs", "tim.zoo.llamas.purchase.cost", source("gets twice as many llamas which cost 50% more each"))
query("sum", "tim.zoo.animal_purchase_costs", "purchase")
collection("ms_estrella.company.employees", "employee", "ms_estrella.company", source("startup company having 10 employees"))
observe(at("ms_estrella.company.employees.count", "current"), 10, "count", source("10 employees"))
observe(at("ms_estrella.company.monthly_funds.amount", "initial"), 400000, "dollar_per_month", source("revenue of $400000 a month"))
percent_of("ms_estrella.company.monthly_expenses.taxes.amount", at("ms_estrella.company.monthly_funds.amount", "current"), 10, source("paying 10% in taxes"))
remove("monthly_tax_payment", "ms_estrella.company", at("ms_estrella.company.monthly_funds.amount", "current"), "ms_estrella.company.monthly_expenses.taxes.amount", source("paying 10% in taxes"))
percent_of("ms_estrella.company.monthly_expenses.marketing_and_ads.amount", at("ms_estrella.company.monthly_funds.amount", "current"), 5, source("5% of the remaining amount on marketing and ads"))

remove("monthly_marketing_and_ads_payment", "ms_estrella.company", at("ms_estrella.company.monthly_funds.amount", "current"), "ms_estrella.company.monthly_expenses.marketing_and_ads.amount", source("5% of the remaining amount on marketing and ads"))
percent_of("ms_estrella.company.monthly_expenses.operational_costs.amount", at("ms_estrella.company.monthly_funds.amount", "current"), 20, source("20% of the remaining amount on operational costs"))

remove("monthly_operational_costs_payment", "ms_estrella.company", at("ms_estrella.company.monthly_funds.amount", "current"), "ms_estrella.company.monthly_expenses.operational_costs.amount", source("20% of the remaining amount on operational costs"))
percent_of("ms_estrella.company.monthly_expenses.employee_wages.amount", at("ms_estrella.company.monthly_funds.amount", "current"), 15, source("15% of the remaining amount on employee wages"))

transfer("monthly_employee_wages", "ms_estrella.company", at("ms_estrella.company.monthly_funds.amount", "current"), at("ms_estrella.company.employees.monthly_wages.amount", "current"), "ms_estrella.company.monthly_expenses.employee_wages.amount", source("15% of the remaining amount on employee wages"))
partition("ms_estrella.company.employees", "ms_estrella.company.monthly_expenses.employee_wages.amount", source("each employee receives the same wage"))
query("value", "ms_estrella.company.employees.member.monthly_wage.amount")
